article.title: Mischief by killing or maiming animal
article.content: Whoever commits mischief by killing, poisoning, maiming or rendering useless any animal shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to five years, or with fine, or with both.
article.html:
325Mischief by killing or maiming animal

Section 325 · Chapter XVII · Of mischief

Whoever commits mischief by killing, poisoning, maiming or rendering useless any animal shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to five years, or with fine, or with both.
